fields.name: seen
fields.description: Set when the tour is finished or closed. The tour then never opens by itself.

fields.name: resume
fields.description: The step the tour opens on next launch: `welcome`, `how-it-works`, `permissions`, `try-it` or `done`.

fields.name: granted
fields.description: Every permission seen granted. A required one that is gone later reopens the permissions screen.

fields.name: relaunchedAt
fields.description: Unix ms of the last automatic relaunch for Screen Recording. Blocks a second one for `RELAUNCH_GUARD_MS`.

fields.name: reopenFix
fields.description: A permissions fix was open at the relaunch, so it opens again at launch. Omitted when false.
